title: Two module pullback comparisons differ by an ordinary target automorphism
statement: Fix shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], schemes X,Y, a morphism a:X -> Y whose tensor pullback is additive, and an arbitrary O_Y-module G. Let c0,c:La*(G[0]) -> (a*G)[0] both satisfy [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map] IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison. Then there exists an O_X-module isomorphism alpha:a*G -> a*G such that c = c0 followed by alpha[0]. No flatness, quasi-coherence, direct image, cover or base-change square is required.

proof.text: Take the functorial bounded-above flat replacement of G[0] with bound zero. Its augmentation s:P→G[0] is a quasi-isomorphism and P is flat termwise and zero above zero. Use flatComplexDerivedPullback to identify the derived pullback of P with its termwise pullback; termwise additive functors preserve strict upper support. Transport this upper support across the localization of s, the derived functor map, and the quotient-comparison isomorphisms. The proved private helper modulePullback_single_isLE concludes La*(G[0])≤0.

For a right-exact additive functor F and a quasi-isomorphism between complexes supported in degrees ≤0, the map of zeroth homology after applying F is an isomorphism. Prove this locally as rightExact_homology_zero_isIso: the outgoing degree-zero differentials vanish, so F preserves the left homology of the corresponding short complexes by Mathlib Functor.preservesLeftHomology_of_zero_g; naturality of mapHomologyIso conjugates the homology map with F applied to the original invertible homology map.

For each comparison c, unpack its witnessing counit ε. On the bounded flat replacement P, compare ε by Functor.leftDerivedUnique with the chosen counit from exists_derivedPullback, transported to the recorded tensorPullback functor by Functor.ext. The chosen counit is invertible on P because P is K-flat, hence ε at P is invertible. Apply H0 to the naturality square for s:P→G[0]. The source vertical map is invertible because s localizes to an isomorphism; the bottom tensor-pullback map is invertible on H0 by the preceding right-exact calculation. Cancel the source vertical isomorphism to deduce that H0(ε at G[0]) is invertible. The final single-complex identification is an isomorphism. This is the proved private helper modulePullbackComparison_homology_zero_isIso.

Let S be the degree-zero single functor, H zeroth homology, M=a*G, and e:H(S(M))≅M its canonical isomorphism. Define α=e⁻¹ followed by H(c0)⁻¹, H(c), and e. Since the source is nonpositive and S(M) is nonnegative, the already proved source-library lemma DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor_map_bijective_of_isLE_of_isGE makes H injective on these morphisms. Apply it to c and c0 followed by S(α.hom). Naturality of singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso and isomorphism cancellation give equality after H, hence the required equality before H. This uses the same truncation route as the original plan; zero modules and empty schemes need no exceptions.

theorem modulePullbackComparison_target_automorphism
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ Y) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).Additive]
    (G : Y.Modules)
    (c₀ c : (derivedPullback a).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G))
    (hc₀ : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison a G c₀)
    (hc : IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison a G c) :
    ∃ α : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback a).obj G,
      c = c₀ ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).map α.hom
